children.label: Glass Saturate (%)
children.help_text: Color saturation of the blurred layer behind the glass. 100 is none; 160 is a typical frost.

children.name: border
children.label: Glass Border Color
children.help_text: Light edge on the frosted text box. Radius is unchanged — still Override Text Box Border Radius.

children.name: border_width
children.label: Glass Border Weight (px)
children.help_text: Width of the glass edge. 0 = no edge.

children.name: rim
children.label: Rim (px)
children.help_text: Thickness of the frosted frame around a solid face. 0 is full-panel glass (no face). 10 matches the animation POC. This is not the glass edge — that is Glass Border Weight.

children.name: face
children.label: Face fill
children.help_text: Solid panel inside the frost. Glass Fill tints the frame only. Hidden when Rim is 0.

children.name: card_grain
children.label: Grain
children.help_text: Film-grain speckle over the content behind each quote card. Same Grain controls as Module Inner.

children.name: background
children.label: Grain Background
children.help_text: Tint behind the speckle. Transparent by default so the hero behind the text box shows through.

children.name: grain_color
children.label: Grain Color
children.help_text: Speckle hue and strength. The color percentage is how visible the grain is (100% = strongest; 0% = none).

children.name: blend
children.label: Grain Blend
children.help_text: How the speckle mixes with the layer below. Normal keeps Grain Color honest. Overlay and Soft Light are film-on-photo. Multiply only darkens; Screen only lightens.

children.name: density
children.label: Grain Density
children.help_text: How many specks per area. Speckle size stays with Grain Scale. Sparse = gappier; Dense = packed.

children.name: scale
children.label: Grain Scale (%)
children.help_text: Speckle size. 100 is default. Lower = finer (smaller specks); higher = coarser (larger specks).

children.name: rim
children.label: Rim (px)
children.help_text: Thickness of the grain frame around a solid face. 0 is full-panel grain (no face). Same as Glass Rim.

children.name: face
children.label: Face fill
children.help_text: Solid panel inside the grain. Grain Background tints the frame only. Hidden when Rim is 0.

children.name: card_pattern
children.label: Pattern
children.help_text: Repeating overlay over the content behind each quote card. Same Pattern controls as Module Inner.
children.inline_help_text: Custom SVG code is at the bottom of the Content tab: Quote Card Pattern — Custom SVG Code.

children.name: style
children.label: Pattern Style
children.help_text: Repeating overlay. Lines include horizontal, vertical, and both diagonals. Custom SVG uses Color Mode (SVG hues vs Pattern Color) and Pattern Size (Repeat vs Fit overlay).
children.inline_help_text: Custom SVG code is at the bottom of the Content tab: Text Box Pattern — Custom SVG Code.
choices: Lines — Top left to bottom right
Lines — Bottom left to top right

children.name: color_mode
children.label: Pattern Color Mode
children.help_text: Override paints the SVG silhouette with Pattern Color (hues in the markup are ignored). Use SVG colors keeps fills and gradients from the markup; Pattern Opacity is strength.

children.name: size_mode
children.label: Pattern Size
children.help_text: Always anchored middle center. Repeat tiles a 256px-wide copy from the center (Scale changes tile size). Fit overlay places one copy from the center (Scale zooms; 100% = text box width).

children.name: background
children.label: Pattern Background
children.help_text: Tint behind the pattern. Transparent by default so the hero behind the text box shows through.

children.name: pattern_color
children.label: Pattern Color
children.help_text: Pattern hue and strength. The color percentage is how visible the pattern is (100% = strongest; 0% = none). Start lower than Grain — a grid at 85% is very strong. Hidden when Custom SVG uses SVG colors.

children.name: opacity
children.label: Pattern Opacity
children.help_text: How strong the SVG artwork is. Hues stay as authored. 0 = none; 100 = full ink.

children.name: blend
children.label: Pattern Blend
children.help_text: How the pattern mixes with the layer below. Normal keeps Pattern Color honest. Overlay and Soft Light are film-on-photo. Multiply only darkens; Screen only lightens.

children.name: scale
children.label: Pattern Scale (%)
children.help_text: Repeat: tile size (lower = tighter). Fit overlay: zoom of the one copy (100% = text box width).

children.name: rim
children.label: Rim (px)
children.help_text: Thickness of the pattern frame around a solid face. 0 is full-panel pattern (no face), including Custom SVG. Same as Glass Rim.

children.name: face
children.label: Face fill
children.help_text: Solid panel inside the pattern. Pattern Background tints the frame only. Hidden when Rim is 0.

children.name: zero_inside_corners
children.label: Zero inside corners
children.help_text: When on, side-by-side cards (768px+) use square corners on inner vertical seams so only the row’s outer corners stay rounded (same as Card Gutter **0**). Use with a non-zero gutter to keep spacing but visually “fuse” the row. **Card Gutter 0** always applies this behavior regardless of this toggle.

children.name: card_border_override
children.label: Override Card Border
children.help_text: Enable to override the theme's default border for cards.

children.name: card_border
children.label: Card Border
children.help_text: Configure border style, width, and color for cards.

children.name: card_border_radius
children.label: Card Border Radius
children.help_text: Corner radius for card borders (px). Only applies when Override Card Border is on.

children.name: image_border_override
children.label: Override Image Border
children.help_text: Enable to override the theme's default border radius for card images. When disabled, the image uses the theme's Global Border Radius (var(--border_radius)). When enabled, select a Style in Image Border below for the border line to appear; Image Border Radius applies regardless.

children.name: image_border
children.label: Image Border
children.help_text: Configure border style, width, and color for card images. Select a Style (e.g. Solid) for the border to appear; an empty Style produces no border line.

children.name: image_border_radius
children.label: Image Border Radius
children.help_text: Corner radius for card images (px). Only applies when Override Image Border is on.

children.name: text_container_padding_override
children.label: Use custom text box spacing
children.help_text: When on, the spacing around the text and button inside each card is controlled by the 'Text box spacing' setting below. When off, that area uses the same padding as the rest of the card (see Card spacing).

children.name: text_container_padding
children.label: Text box spacing
children.help_text: Margin above/below and padding for the text and button area inside each card. Only applies when 'Use custom text box spacing' is on.

children.name: enable_hover_effect
children.label: Enable Hover Effect
children.help_text: Enable hover effect on cards (slight shift and shadow on hover).

children.name: enable_card_as_link
children.label: Enable Card as Link
children.help_text: When on, the entire card is clickable (uses the card button link). When off, only the button links. Only applies to cards that have a button with a link.

children.name: slider_settings
children.label: Slider Settings
children.help_text: Use as slider when cards exceed cards per row. Configure arrows, dots, autoplay, and bounce.

children.name: use_slider_when_overflow
children.label: Use As Slider
children.help_text: When there are more cards than the number per row, show a slider instead of wrapping to the next row. When off, cards wrap as before.

children.name: show_slider_arrows
children.label: Show slider arrows
children.help_text: Show previous/next arrows on the left and right of the slider. Only applies when the slider is active.

children.name: custom_arrows
children.label: Custom arrows
children.help_text: Customize the left and right slider arrows. Use Font Awesome icons (default) or upload images. Size affects both arrows equally. Arrows sit at the slider edges; use Module spacing (padding) to add more or less space around the module if needed.

children.name: arrow_size
children.label: Arrow size
children.help_text: Size of both left and right arrows (px).

children.name: left_arrow_type
children.label: Left arrow
children.help_text: Font Awesome icon or image upload for the previous (left) arrow.

children.name: left_arrow_image
children.label: Left arrow image
children.help_text: Upload PNG, SVG, or other image for the previous (left) arrow.

children.name: right_arrow_type
children.label: Right arrow
children.help_text: Font Awesome icon or image upload for the next (right) arrow.

children.name: right_arrow_image
children.label: Right arrow image
children.help_text: Upload PNG, SVG, or other image for the next (right) arrow.

children.name: arrow_color_choice
children.label: Arrow color
children.help_text: Color for Font Awesome arrows. Only applies when an arrow uses Font Awesome.

children.name: arrow_hover_color_choice
children.label: Arrow hover color
children.help_text: Color when hovering over Font Awesome arrows. Only applies when an arrow uses Font Awesome.

children.name: show_slider_dots
children.label: Show slider dots
children.help_text: Show pagination dots below the slider. Only applies when the slider is active.

children.name: custom_slider_dots
children.label: Custom Slider Dots
children.help_text: Customize the active and inactive dot colors. Only applies when Show slider dots is on.

children.name: slider_dots_active_color
children.label: Active color
children.help_text: Color of the active slide indicator.

children.name: slider_dots_inactive_color
children.label: Inactive color
children.help_text: Color of the inactive slide indicators.

children.name: slider_autoplay
children.label: Auto advance slides
children.help_text: When on, the slider advances to the next slide automatically. Only applies when the slider is active.

children.name: slider_smooth_scroll
children.label: Smooth scroll
children.help_text: When on, the slide transition uses the full seconds-between-slides duration for a smooth scroll instead of a quick jump. Hidden when Continuous scroll is on. Only applies when Auto advance slides is on.

children.name: slider_continuous_scroll
children.label: Continuous scroll
children.help_text: When on, the slider scrolls continuously without stopping. Uses seconds-between-slides to control pacing. Hides arrows and dots. Only applies when Auto advance slides is on.

children.name: slider_bounce
children.label: Slide bounce
children.help_text: When auto-advance is off, a subtle bounce hints that more slides exist. Uses the seconds-between-slides value for frequency. Only applies when Auto advance slides is off.

children.name: slider_autoplay_interval
children.label: Seconds between slides
children.help_text: When auto-advancing: seconds before next slide. When slide bounce is on: seconds between bounce hints.

name: cta_buttons
label: Footer Content
help_text: Add Footer Headings, Footer Content, and one or more buttons below the cards.

children.name: footer_heading_items
children.label: Footer Headings
children.help_text: Headings below the cards. Align Auto uses Footer Content Settings. Color Auto uses Footer Content Text Color. Add a heading to show this grouping.

children.name: heading_text
children.label: Heading
children.help_text: Main heading text. Plain text or raw HTML tags (e.g. strong, em, span).

children.name: heading_size
children.label: Size
children.help_text: HTML heading level (h1–h6). Use Display Size to control how large it looks.

children.name: heading_display_size
children.label: Display Size
children.help_text: Controls how large the heading appears. Independent of the HTML heading level (Size).

children.name: heading_color
children.label: Color
children.help_text: Theme or custom color for this heading. Auto uses Text Color from Content Colors for this grouping.

children.name: heading_color_custom
children.label: Custom Color
children.help_text: Hex color with opacity when Color is set to Custom.

children.name: heading_align
children.label: Align
children.help_text: Horizontal alignment from 992px and up (LG and XL together). Auto uses Content Area Settings Text Alignment for this grouping. Override Tablet/Mobile on this heading to set those breakpoints independently.

children.name: heading_md_text_align_override
children.label: Override Text Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different text alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: heading_md_text_align
children.label: Text Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Text alignment when Override Text Alignment (Tablet) is enabled.

children.name: heading_sm_text_align_override
children.label: Override Text Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different text alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: heading_sm_text_align
children.label: Text Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Text alignment when Override Text Alignment (Mobile) is enabled.

children.name: heading_md_display_size_override
children.label: Override Tablet Display Size
children.help_text: Enable to set a custom display size for this breakpoint.

children.name: heading_md_display_size
children.label: Tablet Display Size
children.help_text: Display size when Override Tablet Display Size is enabled.

children.name: heading_sm_display_size_override
children.label: Override Mobile Display Size
children.help_text: Enable to set a custom display size for this breakpoint.

children.name: heading_sm_display_size
children.label: Mobile Display Size
children.help_text: Display size when Override Mobile Display Size is enabled.

children.name: heading_padding_override
children.label: Override Padding
children.help_text: Enable to override the theme's default padding for this heading. When enabled, you can set custom top and bottom padding values. When disabled, padding is controlled by the theme's display size setting.

children.name: heading_padding_top
children.label: Padding Top (px)
children.help_text: Top padding in pixels when Override Padding is enabled.

children.name: heading_padding_bottom
children.label: Padding Bottom (px)
children.help_text: Bottom padding in pixels when Override Padding is enabled.

children.name: heading_class
children.label: CSS Class
children.help_text: Additional CSS class(es) for this element. Space-separated.

children.name: footer_description
children.label: Footer Content
children.help_text: Rich text below the cards, under Footer Headings.

children.name: footer_content_style
children.label: Footer Content Style
children.help_text: Typography scale for Footer Content rich text only (not headings).

children.name: alignment
children.label: Button Alignment
children.help_text: Horizontal alignment of the buttons (left, center, or right).

children.name: horizontal_align_md_override
children.label: Override Button Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: horizontal_align_md
children.label: Button Alignment (Tablet)
children.help_text: Alignment when Override Button Alignment (Tablet) is enabled.

children.name: horizontal_align_sm_override
children.label: Override Button Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Enable to set a different alignment for this breakpoint.

children.name: horizontal_align_sm
children.label: Button Alignment (Mobile)
children.help_text: Alignment when Override Button Alignment (Mobile) is enabled.

children.name: margin_top
children.label: Space Above Buttons (px)
children.help_text: Vertical space between the content above and this footer button row. Applies on all breakpoints when at least one button is shown. Does not replace per-button Override Button Margins.

children.name: cta_button_items
children.label: Buttons
children.help_text: Add one or more buttons.

children.name: add_icon
children.label: Add Icon
children.help_text: Enable to add a Font Awesome icon to the button.

children.name: purpose
children.label: Purpose
children.help_text: The purpose of the icon, used for accessibility. If set to decorative, an additional attribute of aria-hidden="true" will be added to the icon.

children.name: spacing
children.label: Icon Spacing (px)
children.help_text: Gap between the icon and the button text. Applies on the side the icon is on (Left or Right).

children.name: hide_text
children.label: Hide Button Text
children.help_text: For Simple Link with an icon: hide the label visually so the icon stands alone. The button text stays in the HTML for screen readers.

children.name: override_margins
children.label: Override Button Margins
children.help_text: Set left and right margin for this button only. Other buttons are unchanged unless they also have Override on. Does not replace first-item left or last-item right layout spacing.

children.name: margin_left
children.label: Margin Left (px)
children.help_text: Space before this button only. Ignored on the first button in the row. Independent of this button’s Margin Right and of other buttons.

children.name: margin_right
children.label: Margin Right (px)
children.help_text: Space after this button only. Ignored on the last button in the row. Independent of this button’s Margin Left and of other buttons.

name: inner_pattern_custom_svg_code
label: Module Inner Pattern — Custom SVG Code
help_text: Paste the full <svg>…</svg> markup (not a file). Used when Style → Module Inner → Pattern Style is Custom SVG. Color Mode, Pattern Size, Blend, and Scale stay in Style.
inline_help_text: Used when Style → Module Inner → Pattern Style is Custom SVG.

name: outer_aurora_custom_svg_code
label: Module Outer Aurora — Custom SVG Code
help_text: Paste the full <svg>…</svg> markup (not a file). Opaque shapes on a transparent background, include a viewBox, omit the XML header. One silhouette is used for all three stamps. Aurora Colors paint that shape. Edge blur, Scale, Blend, and Motion stay in Style.
inline_help_text: Used when Style → Module Outer → Blob style is Custom SVG.

name: outer_svg_overlay_code
label: Module Outer SVG Overlay — SVG Code
help_text: Paste the full <svg>…</svg> markup (not a file). Include a viewBox, omit the XML header. Ungroup shapes so each square or path can appear and twinkle on its own. A local sample is images/sw-defaults/sw-hero-svg-overlay-grid.svg. Color, Animation, Position, and Scale stay in Style → SVG Overlay.
inline_help_text: Used when Style → Module Outer → SVG Overlay is enabled. Ungrouped shapes animate best.

name: inner_aurora_custom_svg_code
label: Module Inner Aurora — Custom SVG Code
help_text: Paste the full <svg>…</svg> markup (not a file). Opaque shapes on a transparent background, include a viewBox, omit the XML header. One silhouette is used for all three stamps. Aurora Colors paint that shape. Edge blur, Scale, Blend, and Motion stay in Style.
inline_help_text: Used when Style → Module Inner → Blob style is Custom SVG.

name: outer_animated_custom_svg_code
label: Module Outer Animated — Custom SVG Code
help_text: Not used in the Artwork dropdown (Wave 1–5 only). If this field is shown again: paste full <svg>…</svg> of open stroked paths, fill none, include viewBox, omit the XML header. Do not Outline Stroke or use an opacity mask. Per-path opacity is supported. Gradients, filters, and compound fills are ignored. Motion Roll/Ripple samples strokes (capped).
inline_help_text: Unused while Artwork is Wave 1–5. Ribbon SVG format: open strokes, fill none, no Expand.

name: heading_panel_pattern_custom_svg_code
label: Heading Panel Pattern — Custom SVG Code
help_text: Paste the full <svg>…</svg> markup. Used when Style → Heading Panel → Pattern Style is Custom SVG.
inline_help_text: Used when Style → Heading Panel → Pattern Style is Custom SVG.

name: card_pattern_custom_svg_code
label: Quote Card Pattern — Custom SVG Code
help_text: Paste the full <svg>…</svg> markup (not a file). Used when Style → Quote card → Pattern Style is Custom SVG. Color Mode, Pattern Size, Blend, and Scale stay in Style.
inline_help_text: Used when Style → Quote card → Pattern Style is Custom SVG.

name: background_video_settings
label: Module Background Video
help_text: Set Background Option to Video in the Style tab first, then choose the video source (file, HubSpot video, or embed) and poster image here. Overlay and base color for video are in the Style tab when Video is selected.

children.name: video_source_type
children.label: Video Type
children.help_text: Choose HubSpot Video (Marketing > Video), a video from the File Manager, or an external embed (YouTube, Vimeo, etc.).

children.name: hubspot_video
children.label: HubSpot Video
children.help_text: Select a video from Marketing > Video. Requires Marketing Video in your HubSpot account.

children.name: video_file
children.label: Video from files
children.help_text: Select a video from the File Manager. Shown as background; autoplay muted and loop. Works on all HubSpot tiers (no Video Management required).

children.name: embed_field
children.label: External Embed
children.help_text: Embed a video from YouTube, Vimeo, or other external sources. For autoplay as background, use a URL that includes autoplay and muted if supported.

children.name: poster_image
children.label: Poster image
children.help_text: Shown before the video loads and as fallback if video fails.

name: footer_panel_pattern_custom_svg_code
label: Footer Panel Pattern — Custom SVG Code
help_text: Paste the full <svg>…</svg> markup. Used when Style → Footer Panel → Pattern Style is Custom SVG.
inline_help_text: Used when Style → Footer Panel → Pattern Style is Custom SVG.
